properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 15 at 1:44PM EDT until October 15 at 2:30PM EDT by NWS Mount Holly NJ
properties.description:
At 144 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Bound Brook, moving east at 35 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.
properties.instruction: For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a building.
